title.value: Appeal a denied travel insurance claim

introduction.value: The poster used Gemini during the appeal of a rejected travel insurance claim and says the appeal succeeded.

method.value: The poster uploaded the full travel-insurance policy PDF plus all claim correspondence to Gemini and asked whether the denial fit the policy terms. Gemini reviewed the policy language, said the claim looked valid, suggested an appeal approach, then drafted a professional appeal after the poster added missing trip details; when a second denial arrived, they fed that back into the same thread and Gemini helped build a more detailed rebuttal.

outcome.value: The insurer later reversed course and reimbursed the airline change fee after a final internal review. The poster says the process still took multiple rounds over about five weeks, with Gemini helping most on document analysis and tone.

notes.value: The timeline in the post was roughly three weeks to the first denial, two weeks to the second, and then payment after the final appeal.

notes.en: The source describes about three weeks before the first refusal and two more before the second. Document interpretation and tone were the reported benefits, not instant approval.
